mentions.name: All Zone Files
mentions.description: This service offers bulk domain name datasets for instant download, covering 383 million registered domain names across 1,582 domain zones. Data is updated daily with historical snapshots available, along with daily lists of newly registered and removed/expired domains. Intended uses include marketing, lead gen, SEO, domain research and investing, and data enrichment.
mentions.problem: Obtaining bulk domain name data normally involves submitting application forms and waiting for approvals; this service makes datasets available for instant, hassle-free download.
